title: Wanted-item sourcing service
hypothesis: People will pay a small fee to have an agent search multiple commerce channels for a highly specific hard-to-find item.
target_buyer: Collectors and shoppers with precise item, size, style, condition, or price requirements.
channel: Reddit, Substack, direct referrals, marketplace adapters
smallest_test: Offer a manually fulfilled NZ$15-NZ$29 wanted-item hunt to 10 qualified prospects without depending on one marketplace.
kill_condition: Fewer than 2 qualified prospects from the first 10-target test, or acquisition cost exceeds the test ceiling.
